headline: Bruins steal an overtime thriller against Chicago while Pats head to Miami
morning_brew: I am still exhaling after that overtime win on Saturday. It was absolute madness at the Garden, with the B's digging out of a two-goal hole in the third period just to force the extra frame. Elias Lindholm finally put the dagger in the Blackhawks, and you could hear the relief from the Hub all the way to the North End. That comeback felt like the time my neighbor Rick tried to fix his own roof with duct tape and hope, but somehow, it actually worked. We have been looking for that kind of grit all season, and seeing the team rally when their backs were against the wall was exactly what I needed to see.

Now we shift focus to a massive Sunday in Miami. The Patriots are heading down there, and they have got their work cut out for them with a brutal all-time record against the Dolphins. It is a classic divisional test, and frankly, we need to see Drake Maye and the offense show some real consistency today if we are gonna keep pace. Kickoff is at four-twenty-five, and I will be pacing the living room like a caged animal until the clock hits zero.

The Celtics are also in action this afternoon down in Orlando. They are looking to keep this momentum going, and after watching Payton Pritchard tear it up in the Cup opener, I am feeling pretty good about how this team is playing. It is a busy sports Sunday for the Hub, and while I am still buzzing from that hockey comeback, my focus is entirely on these two road games.

trend_watch.trend: Lindholm buried the game-winning goal in overtime to cap a wild comeback against Chicago.
trend_watch.dans_take: That is the kind of finish that makes you forget the stress and keep the Duck Boat fund alive.

trend_watch.trend: DiPietro stood tall in the crease and stopped thirty-seven shots to help keep the Bruins in the fight.
trend_watch.dans_take: He deserves a steak dinner on me for standing on his head when the defense was taking a nap.

trend_watch.trend: Lohrei jumpstarted the late-game rally with a clutch goal late in the third period.
trend_watch.dans_take: The young gun finally found the back of the net when we needed a miracle.

news_digest.headline: Lindholm's overtime goal lifts the Bruins past the Blackhawks as Pastrnak moves past Bergeron
news_digest.dans_take: That rally was huge, but my heart is too old to be doing this three times a week.

news_digest.headline: The Patriots are 18-43 all time in Miami. Here are keys to a Week 8 victory
news_digest.dans_take: We have been getting cooked in Miami for years, so it is about damn time we start winning.
